items.text: Main slate news largely locked. Malik Nabers (Q, knee) situation murky for SNF; sounds up to him. Giants elevated WR Braxton Berrios and WR Dalen Cambre from PS. Projections updating live; no major other changes expected.
items.why: Full practices but final call personal post-ACL; elevations signal contingency
items.implication: Monitor pre-SNF closely; if out, Fields/Mooney upside; if in, still not 100%
items.opportunity: If OUT, elevated targets to secondary WRs; if ACTIVE, high-upside but risk

items.text: Weekend reports summary: EXPECTED Love (ankle), Odunze (calf). NOT EXPECTED Kamara (knee). ACTIVATED Josh Williams (Sean Tucker doubtful). NO NEWS YET Nabers (knee). Kamara status affects Etienne projections.
items.why: Aggregated weekend/beat reports for main slate
items.implication: Core inactive window intel; projections adjusting
items.opportunity: Etienne lead; TB RB3 Williams if Tucker out (Irving/Gainwell primary)

items.text: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) is expected to play vs Chargers.
items.why: Source expectation; progressing well from high ankle sprain
items.implication: RB upside even if managed; Allgeier goal-line possible
items.opportunity: Carries/routes as explosive lead back candidate

items.text: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (knee/MCL) is not expected to play vs Lions; full participant late in week but not quite ready. Will be inactive; progressed faster than expected but game plan set for next week.
items.why: MCL sprain from preseason; rehab good but not ready for Week 1
items.implication: Saints backfield opens fully for Etienne lead role
items.opportunity: Elevated carries/targets/snaps for backups in NO-DET up-tempo matchup

items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze (calf) is expected to play vs Panthers despite questionable tag and limited practices all week.
items.why: Source confirmation Sunday AM; player said ready Friday
items.implication: Locks in as key CHI WR alongside Burden/Loveland/Swift

items.text: After meniscus trim Tuesday, Raiders believe realistic chance Brock Bowers misses only one game and returns Week 2 at LAC. Team will monitor how he feels this week.
items.implication: Michael Mayer elevated TE1 role Week 1; Bowers stash for ROS
items.opportunity: Targets/snaps to Mayer and other LV pass-catchers vs MIA slow pace

items.text: Falcons QB Cooper Rush (back spasms Sat) feeling better and expected to start vs Steelers. Tua and Penix both inactive; Zaccheaus emergency QB and also emergency 3rd RB (only Bijan and Brian Robinson active at RB).
items.implication: ATL offense limited; Bijan workload protected but pass game down
items.opportunity: Bijan high snap/carry share; limited WR upside

items.text: Jaguars star Travis Hunter is a full-time cornerback today and a part-time WR.
items.why: GameDay confirmation of two-way usage plan
items.implication: Lower WR snap/route share than pure WR expectation
items.opportunity: More to Parker Washington/BTJ; Hunter CB value IDP

items.text: Patriots WR AJ Brown out about six weeks (injury update from GameDay Morning).
items.implication: NE WR room reshuffle; Maye targets elsewhere
items.opportunity: Elevated role for other NE pass-catchers

items.text: Steelers CB Joey Porter Jr unlikely to play vs Falcons due to back injury amid contract dispute; trade possibility remains in play.
items.implication: PIT secondary thinner; ATL pass game slight boost
items.opportunity: Matchup upgrade for ATL WRs/Bijan receiving

items.text: From 10 Facts: Isaiah Likely ranks 4th among TEs in FPP target last 3 yrs; 8/9 games with 6+ targets = 12.5+ PPR. Nabers won't be 100% Week 1; Giants WR2 is Fields or Mooney. Gimme all the Likely.
items.why: Efficiency + Nabers uncertainty boosts Likely targets
items.implication: Strong TE start/stream vs potential Nabers limitation
items.opportunity: Target share spike if Nabers limited/out

items.text: Chuba Hubbard is a flex play this week but viable; keeping it open on The Chubbler.
items.why: Viable flex amid CAR RB committee/questions
items.implication: Startable in flex if needed; monitor Brooks

items.text: Contrarian take on Christian McCaffrey: not worried about preseason usage or Kaelon Black looks. Banged up preseason, long flight, weird game. CMC is a BUY LOW.
items.why: Context of preseason/travel explains soft looks; long-term elite
items.implication: Hold/start confidently; trade target if discounted

items.text: Olave averaged 29% target share and 14.7+ PPR in 75% of games with Shough last year. Lions safeties Branch/Joseph on IR; high O/U. Shough waiver available widely.
items.why: Chemistry + weak DET secondary + game environment
items.opportunity: High target share in up-tempo NO-DET

items.text: Since joining PHI, Saquon Barkley vs WAS (4 games incl playoffs): 136.5 rush yds, 6.0 YPC, 21+ PPR every time. WAS front seven still projects below average.
Herbert FPPPA 52% higher with Joe Alt on field last year. ARI pressure 27th, DL 31st PFF, secondary 26th. Alt healthy ready.
Parker Washington when 70%+ routes: 24% target share; career 15%+ TS = 16.4 PPG. CLE top CB Ward primarily on Brian Thomas Jr.
items.why: Route rate + matchup shadow on BTJ

items.text: When MHJ 50%+ snaps, Michael Wilson 5.5 PPG/13% TS; MHJ off = 28% TS. MHJ expected to play.
items.implication: Fade Wilson if MHJ active; MHJ preferred
